set.body:
Scope
Establish statistical defensibility beyond numerical convergence.

Acceptance criteria
- ModelSpec fits offsets, scaling, loss balancing, graphs, encodings, rank, and penalties inside training folds only.
- Resampling unit is explicit: rows, columns, entries, groups, sites, or errors.
- MCAR, fixed-mask prediction, and any stronger missingness assumptions are clearly separated.
- Deterministic nested tuning and warm-start paths preserve provenance.
- Simulations cover sparse smooth signals, disconnected graphs, p much greater than n, correlated noise, weak eigengaps, block imbalance, and misspecified graphs.
- Reports include subspace error, aligned factor error, support precision/recall, held-out risk, roughness, stability, and block calibration.
- No inferential or support-recovery claim is made without a stated theorem; empirical-only claims are labeled.
set.title: Multivar math 6: fold-safe tuning, missingness, stability, and recovery evidence
